_comment: Canonical source of truth for turva.dev volatile facts. Edit here, then mirror to the surfaces that state these facts (turva-worker/src/worker.js, README.md, the turva-mcp worker and its README, and the erekola profile README), then run: node tools/verify.mjs  (add --live on a networked machine to GET every declared URL and verify the manifest signatures).
_bundledComment: Added 2026-08-31 (Tek-317). Implementation of exactly what a diagnosis lists, sold ONLY together with that diagnosis. These are deliberately NOT in prices/services: verify.mjs binds a priced service to a price key one to one, and a service listed there is a thing an agent can buy on its own. These two cannot be bought on their own, so they are declared on the catalog surfaces (HOME_JSON, A2A services, WebMCP get_services, llms.txt, the services skill) with their requires field, and they are absent from the checkout surfaces (ACP_SERVICES, x402, AP2/MPP/UCP) on purpose. verify.mjs reads this list, so it is the only copy.

_channelsComment: Added 2026-08-16 (Tek-238). The contact channels are declared on many surfaces (footer, JSON-LD sameAs, agent manifests, profile READMEs) and were compared to nothing: only prices had a home here. A channel that is renamed, retired or mistyped on one surface and not another is exactly the drift facts.json exists to stop, and it is the same defect class as the three-versus-four priced services. verify.mjs reads this list, so it is the only copy and the gate is its reader.
_identityRefsComment: Separate from channels on purpose, and the split was found by the gate rather than designed: the first version of the sameAs check assumed every sameAs entry is a contact channel, and it immediately failed on these two. They are identity references, not places to reach a person. There are TWO Wikidata items on purpose and they are not a typo for each other: Q140276251 is turva.dev the organization and Q140276321 is Erik Rekola the person, verified on Wikidata 2026-08-16. An independent review read the pair as drift, which is exactly why both are declared here by name. sameAs is the union of the two lists, and keeping them apart is what lets the gate say which kind of entry an addition is.

isitagentready._categoryScoreComment: score lisattiin 2026-08-30. measuredAt NOUSI 2026-08-20:sta 2026-08-30:aan samana paivana omana muutoksenaan ja omana deploynaan, koska paiva on peilattu viidelle julkaistulle pinnalle (worker.js kolmessa kohdassa, HOME_JSON lastVerified, README.md, docs/agent-readiness.md). Paivan takana on kolme riippumatonta ajoa saman paivan aikana, kaksi koontisession ja yksi tata nostoa varten, ja kaikki kolme antoivat tasmalleen saman kuin 2026-08-20: Level 5/5 ja jokainen kategoria taysi. Luku ei siis muuttunut, vaan se mitattiin uudelleen, ja sivun oma teksti sanoo etta uusi ajo on uusi mittaus eika vanhan vahvistus; ks. työt/kategoriapiste/mittaukset-raw.txt. Ennen sita jokainen pinta toisti KOKONAISPISTEEN jokaisessa kategoriassa, ja verify.mjs vahti sita rivilla joka vaati cell.val === iar.score. Se on oikein vain niin kauan kuin kaikki menee lapi, ja se ansa on kirjattu jo 2026-08-01 (jatko 18) Ansa 4. ARVO ON PISTEMAARA SADASTA, EI TARKISTUKSIA TARKISTUKSISTA, ja se on pakotettu eika valittu: skanneri raportoi eri NIMITTAJAN julkisella sivullaan kuin MCP-rajapinnassaan (commerce 5/5 vastaan 4/4, api/auth 9 vastaan 8), mika oli Tek-296:n koko syy, mutta OSUUS on molemmilla sama koska 9/9 ja 8/8 ovat kumpikin 100. Muoto 100/100 valittiin siksi, etta etusivun taulu kayttaa jo sita eika sen tarvitse muuttua. Kentta checks EI palaa; se on tarkistusten lukumaara ja verify.mjs kaataa ajon jos se ilmestyy.

isitagentready._surfaceWordingComment: Added 2026-08-16 (Tek-225, round 8 section 2). On three surfaces the gate OWNED the wording: the sentence shape was hardcoded in tools/verify.mjs and read from nowhere, so verify.mjs was both the rule and the only record of the rule. Published wording belongs next to the published data, the same way category.label does. verify.mjs now reads these fields and fails if one is missing, so this is not a second copy of a value: it is the only copy, and the gate is the reader.
